items.description: Ensure every ClickHouse table, query, and materialized view follows proven performance rules instead of learning expensive lessons in production.

Agents must read applicable rule files before answering and cite them as Per rule-name, because columnar storage, sparse indexes, and MergeTree mechanics differ from general database intuition. Responses use a Rules Checked, Findings, and Recommendations structure with violations, compliant notes, and prioritized fixes.
